activeRecallQuiz.scenario: A stock forms a symmetrical triangle with a base-to-apex span of 60 trading days. The price meanders quietly inside the coil until Day 54 (90% to the apex) before finally breaking above the upper trendline. How should a disciplined chartist interpret this breakout according to Murphy?
activeRecallQuiz.question: A stock forms a symmetrical triangle with a base-to-apex span of 60 trading days. The price meanders quietly inside the coil until Day 54 (90% to the apex) before finally breaking above the upper trendline. How should a disciplined chartist interpret this breakout according to Murphy?
activeRecallQuiz.correctAnswer: Weak or False Breakout (Dud): Breakouts must occur between the 2/3 and 3/4 distance marks. Beyond 3/4 (Day 45), the coil has lost its explosive coiling pressure and often results in an unreliable, drifting whipsaw.
activeRecallQuiz.explanation: Applying grounded principles prevents catastrophic losses and capital depletion.

coreTakeaways: Always evaluate underlying market assumptions before entering positions.
Separate gross theoretical payoff from real-world net profit.
Follow disciplined risk and position sizing limits on every trade.
